reviews.text:
Had to have our car towed to Chile’s on a Sunday night.  They responded and told us when our car arrived.  They gave us a very fair price (my wife called around and we got a great price).

Super friendly and definitely the place to go if you need car work.
reviews.author: Andy Enright

reviews.text: This is by far one of my worst experiences working with a mechanic shop. I came to get my brakes and rotors changed late last year. Not only did I have a horrible experience while the work was being done I then had an issue with my rotors after work was complete. My rotors were rusted and making grinding sounds like they weren't changed at all!!. It was noticed afterwards because this is secondary vechile which we don't drive much. I went to discuss my concerns and no accountability was taken and the owner was extremely rude when I shared my experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
reviews.author: Awesome Abundant Health Coaching

reviews.text: This is a horrible company they take your money and parts and don’t even change what you asked them to change. I purchased my own rotors and brake pads for them to change but I get a call saying they can’t find my back brake pads and wanted to know if I wanted them to order me some. I told them everything was in my back seat but they swore it wasn’t. When I went to pick my car up guess what? My brake pads were right where I said they was but they were too lazy just to open the door and look and really I seen them from the window. I had to return the brake pads I purchased just to find out they never changed my back rotors but yet they charged me and never gave them back. I would not use this company if I were you! Not sure if they are even legit.
reviews.author: J P

reviews.text: They did a fantastic job on my car, it’s running like new. They responded quickly and answered all my questions, and also have the best price compared to other mechanics in the area.
